notes_for_editor: Keeper dates conflict: LHF has James to 1870 and Agnes 1901-1910; Ecorse history has James d. 24 Sep 1872 and Charles succeeding Andrew in 1901. Marine lists support Mrs A. Hackett 1902/1905 and C. R. Hackett 1914 (matched from OCR column adjacency in the keeper tables; please check page image). Heritage statements say automated 1950s, but the 1924 Marine report says Aga unwatched; the story follows the primary report. Marine volumes are labelled by report year; Canadian fiscal year ended 30 June until 1906, then 31 March. The 1908-labelled range-light discontinuation matches LHF's 1907. Newspapers, Parks Canada statement of significance for the lighthouse itself (pc.gc.ca pages returned only boilerplate) not read. Page numbers for 1902, 1905 not verified.
